name: refuse-smooth-corner
why: Three smoothed edges at a corner. OpenCASCADE builds the twelve blends curvature-continuous (rails at 2e-15 per mm in the patch's harness) but fills each corner with its generic patch, which meets the blends 2.8 degrees off tangent with a curvature jump of 12.9 per mm: not G2, not even G1, on a solid its checker calls valid. So the kernel is not asked: the refusal is read off the selection, names a corner and how many, and says to fillet() the edges that meet. Never silently G1 is the rule this case holds.
